request: 配置 ADC 通道 0-3，12 位分辨率，软件触发
config:
```yaml
Adc:
  general:
    dev_error_detect: true
  AdcGroup:
    - id: 0
      name: AnalogInputs
      trigger_source: SOFTWARE
      conversion_mode: SINGLE
      AdcChannel:
        - id: 0
          name: ADC_0
          resolution: 12
          sampling_time_us: 10
        - id: 1
          name: ADC_1
          resolution: 12
          sampling_time_us: 10
        - id: 2
          name: ADC_2
          resolution: 12
          sampling_time_us: 10
        - id: 3
          name: ADC_3
          resolution: 12
          sampling_time_us: 10
```

request: 配置 ADC 用于温度传感器，带过采样和平均
config:
```yaml
Adc:
  AdcGroup:
    - id: 0
      name: TempSensor
      trigger_source: TIMER
      trigger_timer_us: 1000
      conversion_mode: CONTINUOUS
      AdcChannel:
        - id: 0
          name: TEMP_SENSOR
          resolution: 12
          sampling_time_us: 50
          oversampling: 16
          averaging: true
```
